task: Add Claude Code as a second supported coding agent via a new JSON config file plus templates (CLAUDE.md, equivalents of the other deployable files), with tests that it is discovered and its files deploy to the right places. Record why if app code must change. Do not launch the GUI.

input.question: How are agents, templates and deployment wired, and what must a new agent follow?

output.found: agents/*.json is globbed by core/agent_loader.list_agents; each config has name, base_template_path, structure.base_files (template-relative source -> project-relative destination), project_specific_files (key -> destination, user-written content) and file_descriptions (required for every project-specific key by an existing integrity test). prompt.md in the template folder is shown in the Prompt step. file_deployer copies base files and merges only a destination named .gitignore. Existing integrity tests iterate over all agents/*.json, so a new config is checked automatically.
constraints: Agent config files are named agents/<agent_name>.json
Only core/file_deployer.py writes to the target project
Base template path is a folder with a prompt.md
Every project_specific key needs a file_descriptions entry

input.question: Can the feature be done with only a new JSON config and templates, or must app code change?

output.decision: Use only agents/claude_code.json plus templates/claude-code/; no change to core/ or ui/.
output.why: README and systemPatterns say a new agent is only a JSON file; list_agents globs the folder, file_deployer is driven entirely by the mapping, and the integrity tests iterate over all configs. The one hardcoded 'templates/cline' string in ui/wizard_steps.py is just a placeholder hint for the override field.

alternatives_considered.option: Change ui placeholder to be agent-aware
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Cosmetic, out of scope; task asks to avoid app code unless required

assumptions: Nothing else in the UI hardcodes Cline behaviour (only grep checked, GUI not launched)
risks: The Select Agent step UI with two agents was not visually verified

input.question: Where do the Claude Code files go, and how to name the config?

output.decision: Config agents/claude_code.json (snake_case per systemPatterns and progress.md backlog), name 'Claude Code', template folder templates/claude-code. Rules go to .claude/rules/01-06*.md, workflows become slash commands in .claude/commands/{commit,debug,new-feature}.md, memory-bank/ stays the same, plus CHANGELOG, ROADMAP, CI, ADR, PRE-DEPLOY-CHECKLIST, .gitignore.
output.why: This mirrors the layout used by the Claude Code project that this template family comes from (.claude/rules auto-load, .claude/commands for slash commands). Names match Cline's so behaviour is comparable.

alternatives_considered.option: Reference ../cline files from base_files to avoid duplicating shared files
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The loader joins base_template_path / src, a custom template path override would break, and traversal out of the template folder is fragile

alternatives_considered.option: Name the folder templates/claude-code-templates as in the README example
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: README shows it as an example; existing Cline folder was renamed to the short agent name (progress.md), so follow that

assumptions: Claude Code auto-loads .claude/rules/*.md and .claude/commands/*.md in the project (from documented behaviour, not tested here)
risks: Duplicated shared files (CI, ADR, memory-bank) can drift from the Cline copies

input.question: Should CLAUDE.md be a base file or a project-specific file, and what replaces .clineignore?

output.decision: CLAUDE.md is a static base file that imports @AGENTS.md and the memory-bank files; AGENTS.md, tech-stack, architecture, projectBrief and ROADMAP remain project-specific (user/AI-written). .clineignore is replaced by .claude/settings.json with permissions.deny Read rules for secrets and build output.
output.why: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md, so the import makes the cross-tool AGENTS.md file effective. Keeping CLAUDE.md static means it works even if the user skips content pages. Claude Code has no .clineignore; deny permissions are its mechanism.

alternatives_considered.option: CLAUDE.md as the user-written project-specific file
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Would duplicate AGENTS.md content and require changing the prompt contract; a missing file would leave the project without any Claude entry point

assumptions: @path imports of missing files are ignored without error by Claude Code (not verified)
risks: settings.json deploy overwrites an existing user .claude/settings.json (conflict step will prompt, but there is no JSON merge)

output.notes: No app code changed, confirming the README claim.
